Diagnosis.submission: The nginx-thrift pod (OpenResty Thrift RPC proxy) in the social-network namespace was being OOMKilled due to insufficient memory (16Mi limit). The root cause is a mutating admission webhook called platform-policy-controller (running in the platform-ops namespace, registered as gatekeeper-mutating-webhook-configuration) that intercepts all pod creations in the social-network namespace and unconditionally overrides the container memory resources to 16Mi, overriding the deployment-specified 256Mi limit. This caused the nginx-thrift proxy to be OOMKilled on every start, breaking the Thrift RPC communication layer between microservices. The fix was to delete the gatekeeper-mutating-webhook-configuration mutating webhook configuration and recreate the nginx-thrift pod with its correct 256Mi memory limit.
